title: CAE Simulation Engineer
summary: Uses computer simulation (finite element analysis, a way to predict stress and vibration in parts, and sometimes fluid-flow simulation) to check designs before they are built and tested. Works as the specialist analyst for a product design team in automotive, aerospace, energy or engineering services firms.
dailyDuties: Clean up CAD geometry and build meshes in HyperMesh or ANSA
Set up and run linear and non-linear analyses in ANSYS or Abaqus
Predict fatigue life from load data for durability targets
Compare simulation results with physical test data
Write analysis reports and suggest design changes
Present results in design reviews with the design team

skills.expectation: Run linear static and thermal FEA in ANSYS or a similar solver
Build quality shell and solid meshes in HyperMesh or ANSA
Set up non-linear, contact or explicit analyses in Abaqus or LS-DYNA
Predict fatigue life and durability from load data
Run modal, frequency response and random vibration analyses
Correlate simulation results with physical test data
Write analysis reports and present design recommendations
Run CFD or thermal flow simulations in Fluent or STAR-CCM+
Clean up and simplify CAD geometry before meshing
Automate pre- and post-processing with scripts
Keep analysis reports and methods documents clear
